Step 8 complete. All 308 rejection rows adjudicated from disk, ledger written, gates green.

## Outcome

| | rows | terra | deepseek |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `confirmed_fatal` | 20 | 8 | 12 |
| `confirmed_nonfatal` | 287 | 165 | 122 |
| `false_positive` | 1 | 0 | 1 |

**13 of 218 items carried a real fatal defect — 6.0%.** The agreement signal held: both-lane rejections converted at 10.0%, splits at 3.1%. That rate is above this project's measured 2.7%, and it concentrates in two places — the regularity page and `ai-generated` worked examples — so I flagged it rather than smoothing it over.

The four that mattered most:

- **`thm-counting-lemma-for-a-fixed-graph`** — a wrong estimate. Step 4.1 bounded the exceptional sets by a fraction of the *candidate* set where the cited lemma bounds them by a fraction of the *host* set, so the derived constant didn't follow. Fixed the bookkeeping (γ ≤ (η/2)^h/(2h), apply the typical-degrees lemma to the original pair, c = 2^-h(η/2)^e); the Statement is unchanged.
- **`lem-typical-degrees-in-a-regular-pair`** — a title off by a factor of two (union of two one-sided exceptional sets), which had already propagated into `thm-triangle-counting-lemma-for-regular-triples`'s `[L1]`. Both repaired.
- **`rem-tower-and-wowzer-bounds-in-regularity`** — false. I traced the parameter chain: induced removal needs only a *constant* regularity sequence, so the bound is tower, not wowzer.
- **`ex-gram-determinant-of-two-vectors`** — the title claimed a determinant–area relation the library nowhere establishes. Narrowed.

## Two corrections to my own work

I repaired `ex-depressed-cubic-discriminant` and `cor-monic-resultant-is-unchanged-modulo-f`, then found the same shape across the level — dozens of load-bearing dependencies that are library-proved but undeclared in `deps` (≈15 inner-product items missing `def-inner-product-space`, 7 of 10 tensor items missing the module-structure theorem, 3 flatness items, 5 field items). That's one systemic step-6 residue, not item-level fatals, so R1 required reverting. Both are back byte-exact to the baseline, verified against the frozen hashes, and recorded `confirmed_nonfatal` with the reasoning in their ledger notes.
